minutes.headline: Personnel Committee approved a part-time IT admin assistant job at grade 8 and a fall town meeting article adding three positions to the pay plan.
minutes.summary: The committee approved minutes, a new part-time IT administrative assistant job description, and a fall town meeting article amending the Salary Administration Plan. Members discussed their disagreement with the select board's changes at the last town meeting and how to raise them again. A short Thursday meeting was set for a production technician job description, with the next regular meeting held for October 3.

what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted to send a prepared Salary Administration Plan article to the fall town meeting; it adds three positions to Schedule A of the pay plan.
The committee approved the job description for a new part-time administrative assistant in IT, graded at the same level as other administrative assistants.
The article adds facilities director, IT admin assistant and civilian traffic member to Schedule A of the Salary Administration Plan.
The DPW director job description update was passed over to a later meeting for more work.
A short meeting was set for Thursday, September 15 at 5:15 pm on the production technician job description; the next regular meeting is October 3.

why_it_matters: The Salary Administration Plan sets which town jobs have pay grades, so the fall town meeting article is a vote residents may be asked to take on the town payroll.
The IT assistant job was funded at an earlier town meeting, and a resident asked at this meeting for rejected pay plan changes to be taken up again, so the pay plan may return to the floor.
